speaker: john_heminges
text: Will? John Heminges. From Aldermanbury, with the tailor standing by.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: John. I am at the Theatre. Say the items.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Tomorrow is the full rehearsal, in the apparel. Item, the crown. The old one from Harry the Sixth is gone green at the points. I have had it new gilt, four shillings.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, a looking-glass to be broke every time we play him, which the Master has saved us, and I'll not pretend to grieve.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item. The— the Queen's gown. Nick has grown two fingers since it was cut at Candlemas. My wife says he is out of it at wrist and ankle. The tailor will let it down for eighteenpence, and says there is no more cloth to let.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Well. Eats like two. He sings in the yard of a morning, low, to try it. I do not listen, and I hear it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: You sound like Pope in his bolster. Have it out before Thursday. Gaunt must be heard at the back.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: When this king is buried, John.
